target_specification.intended_dataset_identity: MORP-Synth Peruvian Coastal Dataset (Andre Juarez, Luis Salsavilca, Frida Coaquira, Celso Gonzales, arXiv:2512.02290v1)
author_affiliations: Circulo de Investigacion de Maquinas de Aprendizaje (CIMA)
Departamento de Estadistica e Informatica, Universidad Nacional Agraria La Molina (UNALM), Lima, Peru

expected_sensor_band.value: C-band (5.405 GHz), IW swath, GRD product

expected_geographic_domain.value: Peru (Peruvian Coastal Waters, Southeast Pacific / Humboldt Current Upwelling Zone; 40 scenes spanning Callao, Talara, Ilo)

expected_dataset_structure.value: 2,112 labeled 512x512 patches extracted from 40 Sentinel-1 GRD scenes (2014-2024)

expected_mask_semantics.value: 5 semantic classes harmonized with CleanSeaNet: Sea (0), Oil spill (1), Look-alike (2), Ships (3), Coastal Land (4); binary evaluation focus on {0, 1}

candidate_resolution_evaluation.resolved_title: Quad-Polarization Dataset for Marine Oil Spill and Look-Alike Segmentation

acceptance_criteria: Resolved record must originate from authorized authors (Juarez, Salsavilca, Coaquira, Gonzales) or UNALM/CIMA.
Resolved record must match expected DOI if formally established upon manuscript acceptance.
Resolved record title, description, and keywords must reference Sentinel-1, C-band, and Peruvian coast.
Resolved record must contain mandatory positive keywords ['MORP', 'Peru'].
Resolved record must NOT match any prohibited negative guards.
rejection_criteria: Detection of non-Peruvian domain (Gulf of Mexico).
Absence of mandatory Peruvian / MORP terminology.

mismatches_detected: PROHIBITED_KEYWORD_DETECTED: Record contains prohibited keyword 'Gulf of Mexico'.
MISSING_REQUIRED_KEYWORD: Required keyword 'MORP' was not found in record metadata.
MISSING_REQUIRED_KEYWORD: Required keyword 'Peru' was not found in record metadata.
GEOGRAPHIC_DOMAIN_MISMATCH: Expected region 'Peru' not referenced in record metadata.
AUTHOR_MISMATCH: Expected Juarez et al. (UNALM), found Jamal & Li (Beijing Univ. of Technology).

current_data_access_declaration.literature_finding: arXiv:2512.02290v1 explicitly states under Data and Code Availability that Peruvian ground-truth masks and metadata will be uploaded to Zenodo upon manuscript acceptance.
current_data_access_declaration.github_repository: https://github.com/andrexandrex/MorpSynth (code available, raw dataset rasters and masks omitted)
current_data_access_declaration.zenodo_status: No published record exists on Zenodo for MORP-Synth as of 2026-09-09.
current_data_access_declaration.remedial_action: Dataset acquisition remains strictly blocked pending author communication or manuscript acceptance announcement.
